async def act(page):
    # Continue from the current "Create Product Settings" state.
    # The Attribute Set is already set to Default and Product Type to Simple Product (per the accessibility tree).
    # Click the Continue button to open the product editor. This click will navigate away from the current page,
    # so it must be the last selector-based action in this act() function.

    # Use the full get_by_role path through the table -> row named "Continue" -> button "Continue" to be unambiguous.
    await page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("row", name="Continue").get_by_role("button", name="Continue").click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete (no further selectors after this click in this act()).
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

2) To proceed to the product editor we must click Continue. That click is expected to navigate away from the current page, so per instructions it must be the last selector-based action in this act() call.
3) I used a fully-qualified accessibility path to the Continue button: table -> row (name="Continue") -> button (name="Continue"), which avoids ambiguity.
4) After clicking Continue I wait for networkidle to let the new page load; no further selectors are used in this act() because selectors after navigation are not allowed by the guidance.
